finding: Reforged world-item persistence can bind a validated authoritative save to an atomic SHA-256 integrity sidecar and reject any later byte-level tampering before deserialization is accepted.
world_state_impact: tampered, truncated, or externally modified item-state bytes are rejected before runtime restoration
assumptions: The sidecar protects the Reforged JSON item repository only
Native MajorMUD checksums and journal records remain unresolved
Integrity verification supplements rather than replaces structural runtime validation
fallback: throw InvalidDataException and preserve the authoritative save and integrity sidecar unchanged
